components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The decisive action for authentication, search, upload, and governance workflows.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display:inline-flex; min-height:40px; align-items:center; justify-content:center; gap:8px; padding:0 16px; border:1px solid transparent; border-radius:var(--radius-control); background:var(--color-primary); color:#fff; font:600 14px/1 inherit; cursor:pointer; transition:background-color 140ms ease, transform 80ms ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background:var(--color-primary-hover); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--color-primary); outline-offset:3px; } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform:translateY(1px); } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { cursor:not-allowed; opacity:.55; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: A bordered supporting action for cancel, download, or alternate navigation.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { display:inline-flex; min-height:40px; align-items:center; justify-content:center; gap:8px; padding:0 16px; border:1px solid var(--color-border-strong); border-radius:var(--radius-control); background:#fff; color:var(--color-text); font:600 14px/1 inherit; cursor:pointer; transition:background-color 140ms ease, border-color 140ms ease, transform 80ms ease; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background:var(--color-background); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--color-primary); outline-offset:3px; } .ds-btn-secondary:active { transform:translateY(1px); }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: A low-emphasis action inside cards, rows, and compact toolbars.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { display:inline-flex; min-height:40px; align-items:center; justify-content:center; gap:8px; padding:0 16px; border:1px solid transparent; border-radius:var(--radius-control); background:transparent; color:var(--color-text-secondary); font:600 14px/1 inherit; cursor:pointer; transition:background-color 140ms ease, color 140ms ease; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { background:var(--color-surface-muted); color:var(--color-text); } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--color-primary); outline-offset:3px; } .ds-btn-ghost:active { transform:translateY(1px); }

components.name: Danger Button
components.description: A clearly destructive action reserved for irreversible governance operations.
components.css: .ds-btn-danger { display:inline-flex; min-height:40px; align-items:center; justify-content:center; gap:8px; padding:0 16px; border:1px solid transparent; border-radius:var(--radius-control); background:var(--color-error); color:#fff; font:600 14px/1 inherit; cursor:pointer; transition:background-color 140ms ease, transform 80ms ease; } .ds-btn-danger:hover { background:#991b1b; } .ds-btn-danger:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--color-error); outline-offset:3px; } .ds-btn-danger:active { transform:translateY(1px); }

components.name: Search Field
components.description: A border-led search control for policies, documents, and administration lists.
components.css: .ds-search { display:flex; min-height:42px; align-items:center; gap:9px; padding:0 12px; border:1px solid var(--color-border); border-radius:var(--radius-control); background:#fff; color:var(--color-text-muted); transition:border-color 140ms ease, box-shadow 140ms ease; } .ds-search:focus-within { border-color:var(--color-primary); box-shadow:0 0 0 4px rgb(181 18 27 / 13%); } .ds-search input { width:100%; min-width:0; border:0; outline:0; background:transparent; color:var(--color-text); font:400 14px/1.6 inherit; } .ds-search input::placeholder { color:var(--color-text-subtle); } .ds-sr-only { position:absolute; width:1px; height:1px; overflow:hidden; margin:-1px; clip:rect(0,0,0,0); white-space:nowrap; }

components.name: Verified Status
components.description: A text-plus-dot status for current, active, reviewed, or successful records.
components.css: .ds-status-success { display:inline-flex; min-height:24px; align-items:center; gap:6px; padding:3px 9px; border:1px solid #bbf7d0; border-radius:999px; background:var(--color-success-soft); color:var(--color-success); font:600 12px/1.3 inherit; white-space:nowrap; } .ds-status-success > span { width:6px; height:6px; border-radius:50%; background:currentColor; }

components.css: .ds-document-card { display:grid; min-width:0; grid-template-columns:auto minmax(0,1fr); gap:16px; align-items:start; padding:20px; border:1px solid var(--color-border); border-radius:var(--radius-card); background:#fff; color:var(--color-text); transition:border-color 140ms ease, box-shadow 140ms ease; } .ds-document-card:hover { border-color:var(--color-border-strong); box-shadow:0 1px 2px rgb(16 24 40 / 3%), 0 8px 24px rgb(16 24 40 / 5%); } .ds-document-icon { display:grid; width:42px; height:42px; place-items:center; border-radius:var(--radius-control); background:var(--color-primary-soft); color:var(--color-primary); } .ds-document-heading { display:flex; align-items:flex-start; justify-content:space-between; gap:10px; } .ds-document-heading strong { font-size:15px; line-height:1.45; } .ds-document-heading span { padding:4px 7px; border-radius:999px; background:var(--color-success-soft); color:var(--color-success); font-size:10px; font-weight:600; white-space:nowrap; } .ds-document-card p,.ds-document-card small { display:block; margin:6px 0 0; color:var(--color-text-muted); font-size:12px; }

components.css: .ds-citation { display:flex; min-width:0; flex-direction:column; gap:7px; padding:14px; border:1px solid var(--color-border); border-radius:12px; background:#fff; color:var(--color-text); text-decoration:none; transition:border-color 150ms ease, background-color 150ms ease; } .ds-citation:hover { border-color:color-mix(in srgb,var(--color-primary) 30%,white); background:var(--color-background); } .ds-citation:focus-visible { outline:3px solid color-mix(in srgb,var(--color-primary) 35%,white); outline-offset:2px; } .ds-citation-topline { display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:space-between; gap:8px; } .ds-citation-topline b { color:var(--color-primary); font-size:10px; letter-spacing:.04em; } .ds-citation-topline em { padding:4px 7px; border-radius:999px; background:var(--color-success-soft); color:var(--color-success); font-size:9px; font-style:normal; font-weight:600; } .ds-citation > strong { font-size:13px; line-height:1.4; } .ds-citation dl { display:grid; grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr)); gap:8px; margin:2px 0 0; } .ds-citation dt,.ds-citation dd { margin:0; font-size:10px; line-height:1.4; } .ds-citation dt { color:var(--color-text-muted); } .ds-citation dd { color:var(--color-text); font-weight:500; } .ds-citation p { margin:4px 0 0; color:var(--color-primary); font-size:11px; font-weight:700; }

components.css: .ds-table-wrap { width:100%; overflow-x:auto; border:1px solid var(--color-border); border-radius:var(--radius-card); background:#fff; } .ds-table { width:100%; min-width:560px; border-collapse:collapse; color:var(--color-text-secondary); font-size:14px; font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums; } .ds-table th { padding:11px 16px; border-bottom:1px solid var(--color-border); background:var(--color-background); color:var(--color-text-muted); font-size:12px; font-weight:650; text-align:left; white-space:nowrap; } .ds-table td { padding:14px 16px; border-bottom:1px solid var(--color-border); } .ds-table tr:last-child td { border-bottom:0; } .ds-table tbody tr:hover { background:#fbfdff; } .ds-table td span { display:inline-flex; padding:3px 9px; border:1px solid #bbf7d0; border-radius:999px; background:var(--color-success-soft); color:var(--color-success); font-size:12px; font-weight:600; } .ds-table:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--color-primary); outline-offset:3px; }

narrative.overview:
The Verified Academic Desk treats PolicyMate AI as an institutional workspace: calm, document-led, and explicit about evidence. Academic red identifies decisive actions, active navigation, and institutional anchors; paper white and slate neutrals carry the reading work.

Density adapts to the job. Student flows keep a spacious task-first foreground, while admin views become compact enough for tables and governance without compressing labels or status context. The product narrative moves from authentication, to cited search and answers, to official PDF inspection, then to version, access, and RBAC administration.

Depth is light and border-led. Motion is brief and functional, Lucide line icons clarify actions, and every important status remains readable without relying on color alone.
keyCharacteristics: Academic red is reserved for identity, primary actions, focus, and active state.
Paper-white surfaces sit on a cool archive canvas with slate typography.
Citations, validity, version, and access state stay adjacent to the content they qualify.
Student surfaces breathe; admin surfaces use compact, scannable rows and tables.
Lucide line icons reinforce function without becoming decoration.

rules.name: The Academic Red Rule
rules.body: HUST red marks identity, primary actions, focus, and selected state; status semantics keep their own verified green, review amber, error red, or reference blue.

rules.name: The Evidence Color Rule
rules.body: Validity and workflow colors always appear with a label or icon; color is never the only carrier of state.

rules.name: The Document First Rule
rules.body: Headlines are compact and decisive; body copy stays readable, while operational metadata uses smaller labels without hiding version, issuer, or effective date.

rules.name: The Task-First Viewport Rule
rules.body: Keep the current question, answer, document, or governance task visible before secondary material; collapse columns instead of squeezing them.

rules.name: The Border Before Shadow Rule
rules.body: Use a 1px border as the default surface boundary; reserve stronger shadows for overlays, hover lift, and signature showcase moments.

rules.name: The Soft Utility Rule
rules.body: Use 9–10px corners for controls, 12–14px for cards and panels, and full pills only for status or compact tags.

rules.name: The Citation Is Navigation Rule
rules.body: Citation cards must expose document type, validity, reference, version/page context, and an affordance to open the official source.

dos: Do use Academic HUST Red for identity, primary actions, focus, and active navigation.
Do keep citations, document version, validity, issuer, and effective date beside the answer or source they qualify.
Do use 1px slate borders and paper-white surfaces as the default hierarchy before adding shadow.
Do collapse multi-column layouts at their observed breakpoints and preserve 44px touch targets where the build already provides them.
Do pair Lucide icons with text or accessible names and honor reduced-motion preferences.
donts: Don't introduce gradients or heavy glass as a recurring identity device; the build's isolated showcase and loading effects are exceptions, not system primitives.
Don't replace Academic HUST Red with the blue literals that remain in the legacy `/student` route or one-off admin accents.
Don't turn compact admin labels into unlabeled icon-only controls or color-only status.
Don't stack cards inside cards when a divider, row, or two-column layout keeps evidence relationships clearer.
Don't use pill radii for general cards, fields, or buttons.
